## Context

The live automatic Sentry proof created ready game-api issues, but Symphony remained idle. Replaying the exact tracker request returned nginx HTTP 403 until X-Project-Id was added. bos-mcp already sends this required routing header; Symphony's GameApi client does not.

## Expected outcome

Symphony authenticates and routes tracker reads correctly, sees ready issues across configured repositories, and starts automatic implementation runs.

## Scope

- Add the configured target project header to all GameApi client requests.
- Validate the required configuration and add regression tests.
- Build and install the exact tested escript, then restart the user service.

## Out of scope

- Changing GitHub access architecture.
- Embedding credentials in code.
- Changing game-api hosting.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every GameApiTrackerAdapter request includes X-Project-Id from BOS_API_TARGET_PROJECT_ID.
- A missing target project ID fails configuration validation instead of silently polling zero work.
- Tracker client tests cover the routing header.
- The installed Symphony service sees and claims eligible game-api issues after restart.
